$comment: Stage B (issue #1187's normalization template) design for issue #1197: every ROLE package (docs/contracts/role-loop-archetypes.json's own `roles` map) declares a matrix of its own foundry.capabilities (rows) by the five loop stages (docs/contracts/loop.json's `stages`, columns), so its skill's "Run the feedback loop" section can be GENERATED (scripts/generate-loop-section.mjs) rather than hand-written, and scripts/check-loop-matrix.mjs can fail a committed section that has drifted from it. An executable-tooling package (docs/contracts/package-evidence.json's own category: "executable-tooling", e.g. launcher, starter) has no capability x stage loop by design and is out of scope for this file -- issue #1187 comment 5800189482, Decision 1. Depends on package-framework.json version 3's `capabilities` field (issue #1196) and the loop engine contract (./loop.json, issue #1195), both Stage A. This file is intentionally its own contract rather than a new package-framework.json field: package-framework.json's own governance.changeProcedure asks a version bump to bring every package into conformance in the same change, which this Stage B wave deliberately does not do (packages convert in Stage C, per the owner's #1187 normalization direction) -- the same deferral precedent version 3 itself already set for the per-role capability maps. A package opts in by shipping the file at the fixed, convention-based path below; no manifest field is required to declare it exists, so adopting it never touches the Stage A contract.
path: packages/<pkg>/loop-matrix.json, sibling to that package's own package.json -- a fixed convention path, not a manifest-declared one, so Stage C conversions do not touch docs/contracts/package-framework.json
rule: `role` is the exact package name this file belongs to (must equal the sibling package.json's own `name`). `cells` has exactly one entry per (capability, stage) pair, for every id in that role's own `foundry.capabilities[].id` (docs/contracts/package-framework.json) crossed with every stage in docs/contracts/loop.json's `stages` -- no fewer, no more, no duplicates. A cell is either applicable, with `inputs`/`check`/`output`/`proofCase` all present, or declared `n/a` (`applicable: false`) with a non-empty `reason` -- a stage is never silently skipped (#1197: "for example, Customer has no `act` that writes files"). The operating mode (docs/contracts/role-loop-archetypes.json's `roles[<role>].primaryMode`, resolved through `modes[<mode>].stageActivities[<stage>]`) supplies each stage's DEFAULT meaning; an applicable cell's `inputs`/`check`/`output`/`proofCase` supply this one capability's own content for that stage -- the generator composes both, and never restates the mode's default prose per cell.

cellShapes.capability: string -- must match one of this role's own `foundry.capabilities[].id` entries exactly
cellShapes.stage: one of docs/contracts/loop.json's `stages` (sense | judge | act | verify | learn)
cellShapes.reason: string, required when applicable is false, forbidden (must be omitted) when applicable is true -- the stated reason this stage does not apply to this capability
cellShapes.inputs: string, required when applicable is true -- what this stage gathers for this capability, beyond the mode's own default sense/judge/act/verify/learn activity
cellShapes.check: string, required when applicable is true -- the check this stage runs for this capability (a check id, a gate name, or a one-sentence description; not itself validated against a registry in this wave)
cellShapes.output: string, required when applicable is true -- a package-relative path, same pathRule as package-framework.json's `outputs` field (relative, no leading '/', no '..' segment, first two segments exactly `clossys/<role-name>`)
cellShapes.proofCase: string, required when applicable is true -- a case id from this role's own qualification adapter, governance/release-qualification-adapters/<role>/current-direct.json (`cases[].id`), same convention package-framework.json's `solves.proofCase` and `capabilities[].proofCase` already use
cellShapes.demand: object, required when applicable is true -- what this step demands, per issue #1197's scope addition (owner-approved 2026-09-22, #1219): `{ reasoningTier: "light" | "standard" | "deep", minimumTierFloor: optional same enum, visionRequired: boolean, contextSize: "small" | "medium" | "large" | "extra-large", parallel: boolean, independence: boolean }`. `minimumTierFloor`, when present, must not exceed `reasoningTier` (a floor above the declared tier is incoherent). No field here or anywhere else in this file may name a model: #1219 maps tiers to a host's current models through Launcher's per-host profile, never a package.

enforcement.rule: scripts/check-loop-matrix.mjs runs in REPORT MODE by default, the same discipline as package-framework.json's own gate: a package with no loop-matrix.json file is printed and counted, never a failure -- adoption is Stage C. A package that DOES ship the file is checked for shape (every field above) regardless of mode, and, when that role's own skill/SKILL.md contains a `## Run the feedback loop` section, that section is regenerated from the matrix (scripts/generate-loop-section.mjs) and diffed byte-for-byte against the committed one: a mismatch is ALWAYS a failure, in both modes -- prose and data are not allowed to diverge once a package has adopted the matrix, the same rule scripts/check-conversation-contract.mjs already applies to the shared conversation contract. Pass --enforce to additionally fail on absence (no loop-matrix.json, or a matrix with no corresponding generated section in the skill), for the later wave once every package has converted.

governance.rule: No package hand-writes its own "Run the feedback loop" skill section once it has adopted this file. scripts/generate-loop-section.mjs is the one generator; @clossys/launcher composes with the same output at pack time (mirrors how it already composes docs/contracts/conversation-contract.md, issue #1182).
governance.changeProcedure: A change to `cellFields`, `cellShapes`, or the demand sub-schema is exactly one pull request: it bumps this file's own `schemaVersion` and scripts/generate-loop-section.mjs / scripts/check-loop-matrix.mjs in the same change.
